findings: Final-OR factoring has the stated local Boolean identity and one-gate saving when final-region rebuilding is available; it is explicitly unformalized and does not cover different paths or general sharing.
Cofactor pooling records the r-minus-one new OR cost rather than assuming it is paid by deleting the dirty gate.
The private zero-singleton cleanup argument correctly uses a true AND in the cleanup cone to prevent new ownership, while retaining privacy/topological conditions and unformalized status.
The outside singleton example is compatible with triangle/C4 freeness and does not establish a repair cost.
scope: No Lean result or full normalization, minimum-star theorem or refutation is claimed.
